hypothesis: If every link on the channels we control (IG/TikTok/X bio, Reddit posts, email) carries a consistent ?src=, the share of sessions with a known source rises enough to read the channels.
kpiTarget: Sessions with a known source / total sessions: from 13/400 (3%, Oct 5 snapshot, 30 days) to ≥ 30%
dataSource: Dashboard → «Sessions by source» (sources query, page_view events with session_id)
duration: 14 days from when all the links are tagged
decisionThreshold: ≥ 30% → scale: tag mandatory on every new link. 10–30% → fix: find the untagged links. < 10% → the problem is the loss of sessions (G10), not the tags

hypothesis: If the plans page makes clearer what you get, more visitors click a plan's CTA.
kpiTarget: plan_cta_click / plan_view: from 4/126 (3.2%, Oct 5 snapshot, 30 days) to ≥ 6%
duration: Before/after, 4 weeks per side: with these volumes an A/B test has no statistical power. At least 120 plan_view per side
decisionThreshold: ≥ 6% with at least 120 plan_view → scale. 3–6% → fix (change another element). ≤ 3% → kill the variant

hypothesis: If friction is removed from the registration form (fewer fields or one step less), a larger share of those who start it complete the registration.
kpiTarget: signup_completed / signup_started: from 24/66 (36%, Oct 5 snapshot, 30 days) to ≥ 50%
dataSource: Dashboard → funnel (signup_started, signup_completed) and, as a check, new profiles in profiles
duration: Before/after, 4 weeks per side. At least 60 signup_started per side
decisionThreshold: ≥ 50% and consistent new profiles → scale. 36–50% → fix. No improvement → kill. Careful: 52 of the 66 signups have no session, so the figure has to be compared with profiles
